2. Both political camps interpret high turnout as favorable to them.
3. Special feature: President Lee Jae-myung (이재명) posted extreme messages on Twitter quoting Plato, saying if you don't vote, you'll be ruled by the worst scum, which is seen as extreme polarization politics.
4. Former presidents also participated in this extreme polarization.
5. Early voting was about 3% higher, and current turnout is about 4% higher than last local elections.
